clause: Fill & gradient tools + fg/bg fill + stroke-selection [STU-RAS-025]

scope.summary: Implement the fill/gradient primitives: a bucket/flood fill (fills similar contiguous areas with a color or StudioPattern by tolerance and anti-alias); a gradient tool drawing/editing StudioGradient fills interactively on layers, fill layers, and masks with on-canvas stop handles; gradient geometry modes Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected, Diamond; and foreground/background fill and stroke-selection commands. Gradients/patterns authored here are the same StudioGradient/StudioPattern primitives used by fill layers and effects (do not fork).
acceptance_criteria: Bucket/flood fill by tolerance with color+pattern
expected_tests: live: bucket fill a tolerance-bounded region with a color and with a pattern; draw a radial gradient with on-canvas stop handles and edit a stop
live: fill-foreground and stroke-selection commands render expected pixels; all 5 gradient geometry modes render
acceptance_criteria_original: bucket/flood fill by tolerance with color+pattern
gradient tool with 5 geometry modes + on-canvas stops; fg/bg fill + stroke-selection

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-025]** Studio MUST provide fill and gradient primitives: a bucket/flood fill filling similar contiguous areas with a color or `StudioPattern` by tolerance and anti-alias; a gradient tool drawing and editing `StudioGradient` fills interactively on layers, fill layers, and masks with on-canvas stop handles; and gradient geometry modes Linear, Radial, Angle, Reflected, and Diamond. Foreground/ background fill and stroke-selection commands MUST be provided. Gradients and patterns authored here are the same `StudioGradient`/`StudioPattern` primitives used by fill layers and effects.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
